title: feat: add optional "other" answers to the Bee Census
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds an optional one-line "other" field under bee type, what you make, how you found us, other AI tools, blockers, and what you'd pay for.
- Adds an optional "which payment method would you use" field under blockers, asking for the method and country.
- Adds a "🐝 Something else" option to the required bee-type dropdown.
- GitHub issue forms can't attach free text to an option, so each follow-up is a separate optional input. Only the issue template changes; the quest checks the issue title only.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: The census has an other box
gist.blurb: Not every bee fits neatly in a dropdown. The Bee Census now has room for answers the form didn’t think of.
gist.summary: The Bee Census GitHub issue form adds optional “other” answers to six questions, a payment-method-and-country follow-up under blockers, and a “🐝 Something else” bee-type option; quest checks still use only the issue title.
gist.impact: People filling out the census can describe answers that don’t fit the preset choices without changing how the quest is checked.
gist.visual_concept: Polli helps fill out a friendly census form beside a garden of different flowers, with one open text box representing answers beyond the preset choices. Give her a tiny pencil; keep the form welcoming rather than depicting a rigid checklist.
